fixed.climate: a small upstairs room on a hot summer afternoon: warm and stuffy, becoming close and airless once Alice fills it (geography.json LOC-rabbits-house-room)

dream_design.flora: the climbing roses and honeysuckle of the exterior show at the window; a small vase of sweet peas on the table in the window
dream_design.ornament_cues: walls and ceiling papered in a flowing poppy-and-vine pattern; the window is a rounded arch with a stained-glass rose roundel in its top light, so the sun lays soft coloured tints on the table; the fireplace has a tiled floral surround (form and material belong to architecture; the fan, gloves and the little bottle stay 1862 props, WR-009)
dream_design.palette: ivory and dusty-rose wallpaper, sage and pale gold, the window's rose-and-amber tint; once Alice's arm blocks the window the room drops to muted rose-brown
dream_design.seasonal_guard: summer flowers at the window and on the table
dream_design.reason: The room, table in the window, fan, gloves and bottle are explicit (ch004-p05..p07). Pattern, glass tint and palette are designed to WR-010; the window_light states (open_window_sun / window_blocked) are unchanged.

fixed.window: a single window with the table set in it; the sunny afternoon yard outside. Once Alice's arm fills the frame, most of the daylight is blocked.
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from an upstairs room of the family house as the housemaid keeps it, on a July afternoon: sun through the window and warm, still indoor air. When she is wedged in, the heat and stuffiness become her panic.

source.quote: By this time she had found her way into a tidy little room with a table in the window

fixed.reason: The room, window and chimney are explicit (ch004-p05, ch004-p07). The source gives no air or light, so the afternoon values are carried from the continuous clock and ruling 5.2 A.

states.diegetic_daylight: afternoon sun through the window onto the table, fan and gloves, with a band of warm light on the floor; after ch004-p07 her arm out of the window blocks most of it
states.conditions: warm, dusty, still indoor air; floating dust in the window light

source.quote: she put one arm out of the window, and one foot up the chimney

states.reason: The window and chimney are explicit (ch004-p05, ch004-p07). Sun, air and clock are designed from the continuous dream clock.

states.diegetic_daylight: the window is filled by Alice's arm, so only slivers of afternoon light get in round it; the pebbles come in through that gap. Full light returns once she has shrunk and before she runs out.
states.conditions: close, airless, hot; soot drifting from the chimney after Bill is kicked up it

source.quote: as the door opened inwards, and Alice’s elbow was pressed hard against it, that attempt proved a failure
